notes: καθὼς καί rendered by a bare 'even as' with no correlative 'so': rule 82 names 2CO.11.12 (καθὼς καὶ ἡμεῖς -> 'even as we') and EPH.2.3 (ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί -> 'even as the rest') as the units where the bare-'even' gloss carries to the καί. The verse pass read rule 82's heading clause as licensing 'even as' whole on the comparative and emptied the καί, which rule 65's English-side test forbids where the ASV has written a word. Only s028 and s029 change.
